title: Nightshift rules
description: Owner knobs for an unattended shift. Extra top-level keys are rejected; missing optional keys keep runtime defaults. toolDeny and both host-native ask-tool entries are required so question behavior is never hidden. An empty string lifts a string rule. Schema validation never changes hook behaviour.

$schema.description: Optional pointer for editors. Ignored by Nightshift runtime.

toolDeny.description: Exact host tool_name to denial message. A non-empty value denies that tool with this message; an empty value lifts this map entry; an unlisted optional tool is allowed by this map. Other hardhat guards still apply independently. AskUserQuestion is Claude Code's native question tool and request_user_input is Codex's. Codex file edits report apply_patch (Edit and Write are matcher aliases only). Other built-in and MCP names may be added when that host exposes them to PreToolUse. Examples and host coverage: https://github.com/orwa-mahmoud/nightshift/blob/main/docs/knobs.md#tool-rules

AskUserQuestion.description: Claude Code question policy. Non-empty parks with this denial; empty allows Claude Code to ask and wait.

request_user_input.description: Codex question policy. Non-empty parks with this denial; empty allows Codex to ask and wait.

examples.request_user_input: Park the question with a default and continue.
examples.Bash: Shell commands are disabled for this shift.
examples.mcp__github__delete_file: Repository deletion is disabled for this shift.

forbiddenCommands.description: grep -E pattern matched against Bash command text during a shift. Empty disables the guard.

neverCommitPatterns.description: grep -E pattern matched against a commit diff during a shift. Empty disables the guard.

expectedEmail.description: During a shift, deny commits authored under any other identity. Empty disables the guard.

protectedDirs.description: Space- or pipe-separated directory names never to git add/commit/tag/remote during a shift. Empty disables the guard.

stallMax.description: 0 holds a stuck run (default). N clocks the shift out after N stuck stop attempts.

stallWarnEvery.description: Warn in the shift log every N stuck stop attempts while holding. 0 disables the cadence warning.

watchMinutes.description: Minutes between watchman wakes. 0 disarms the watchman.

watchRetrySeconds.description: Space-separated seconds between revival attempts in one wake, e.g. "30 120".

watchAgent.description: Optional owner revival command. Empty keeps the host default resume ladder. A non-empty value is used verbatim on every revival attempt (no resume/--continue/fresh ladder).

receiptsAutoCommit.description: When true, clock-out and Archive commit the local receipts repo ($NS/.git) with the headless nightshift identity. Default false: even if Setup created that repo, the owner commits it. Missing or unreadable is treated as false.

notifyCommand.description: Unrestricted owner-provided shell run at shift-end or unrecoverable outage. Empty is silent.

revivalPrompt.description: Order a resumed conversation receives after a crash or outage.

freshRevivalPrompt.description: Order a fresh-session fallback receives when the recorded conversation cannot be resumed.

clockOutMessage.description: Text the Stop hook re-injects when open punch-list items remain.

retention.description: Optional history retention. 0 keeps forever. Only Nightshift Archive may prune, and only after a printed preview and explicit confirmation.

runtimeLogDays.description: Delete Nightshift-generated runtime logs older than N days. 0 keeps forever.

archiveDays.description: Delete dated .nightshift/archive/YYYY-MM-DD directories older than N days. 0 keeps forever.
